  CHRISTOPHER LANDGRAF, PRO SE INTERVENOR’S RESPONSE TO ONCOR
  AND LCRA’S OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS’ EXHIBITS LISTED IN
                ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30
I am Christopher Landgraf, pro se intervenor. I am identified as Party Number 113. This

is a response to Oncor and LCRA’s objections to certain intervenors’ exhibits listed in

attachment A of SOAH Order No. 30 (PUC Interchange Item Number 5936). Below are

responses to both bullets pertaining to me in their filing and concluding statements.

‘Ex. 1 was late filed direct testimony.’

My original direct testimony was filed on 5/13/2026 at 8:06 AM, before the deadline

(please see PUC Interchange Item Number 3977). My original direct testimony

contained Exhibits A through I embedded in it. Applicants objected to Exhibits G

through I in my original direct testimony on PUC Interchange Item Number 4726, so I

submitted updated direct testimony on PUC Interchange Item Number 5093, which
  RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA’S OBJECTIONS TO CERTAIN INTERVENORS’
                    EXHIBITS LISTED IN ATTACHMENT A OF SOAH ORDER NO. 30
                                                                      PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                              SOAH Docket
                                                                          No. 473-26-16349

 struck Exhibits G through I (this was done prior to SOAH Order Number 20 which

denied applicant’s motions to strike). My updated direct testimony contains no material

changes and only struck Exhibits G through I in my original direct testimony. The filing

date of 5/22/2026 for my updated direct testimony gives the impression that my direct

testimony was filed late. I uploaded my updated direct testimony, with embedded

Exhibits A through F within it, as Exhibit 1 to Kiteworks and Egnyte the 12:00 AM hour

of 6/3/2026 (before the deadline); see PUC Interchange Item Number 5479 as notice of

submission. Since my exhibits were embedded within my direct testimony and because

I hadn’t originally labeled my direct testimony as an exhibit, I identified my direct

testimony with embedded exhibits as Exhibit 1 to try and limit confusion.

‘Ex. Nos. A-F are duplicative of what is included in Ex. 1.’

Please see my previous response above and my related response to SOAH Order

Number 30, and my updated exhibit list, on PUC Interchange Item Number 5892. Based

on SOAH Order Number 30 statement of ‘Ex A through F. Add testimony as Ex G’ for

me (Party Number 113), I separated my Exhibit 1 updated direct testimony (with

embedded Exhibits A through F) into separate files, updated and uploaded my Exhibit

List accordingly, and uploaded separate files for Exhibits A through G (with G being my

direct testimony) into Kiteworks and Egnyte. I also stated (on PUC Interchange Item

Number 5982) that “Exhibit 1 and the original Exhibit List that I uploaded to Kiteworks

and Egnyte on 6/3/2026 can be deleted as they’re now redundant with the new

                                                                             No. 473-26-16349

 uploads.” Agreed that Exhibits A through F are duplicative of what is included in Exhibit

1.

In conclusion, Exhibits A through G which I uploaded to Kiteworks and Egnyte on

6/5/2026 should be admitted into the record at the start of the hearing on the

merits, scheduled to begin on June 8, 2026. They should be admitted since my

original direct testimony with embedded exhibits was submitted at 8:06 AM on

5/13/2026 (before the deadline) by PUC Interchange Item Number 3977 and my

current Exhibits A through G are materially the same as what I had originally

submitted (only struck 3 exhibits based on PUC Interchange Item Number 4726

objections and made separate files for current Exhibits A through G based on

SOAH Order Number 30). For reference, below is my updated exhibit list from

6/5/2026.
